amendments_before_primary_analysis: Existing social account data replaced by a separately collected, publisher-single-bylined corpus; restricted two-narrative scope declared.
Weak local 1.5B text annotation attempt excluded after unsupported political attribution in content-only QA; fixed blinded assistant labels plus independent diagnostic NLI assessment used instead.
Early 1.5B rewrite feasibility attempt excluded after changed causal claims; final 3B Q4_K_M weights and balanced demonstrations frozen before primary generation.
Future-tense and quotation guards added after content-only inspection of first 3B paraphrase, before model evaluation.
Full-input guards added: MiniLM 256 tokens, MPNet configured max length, bidirectional NLI 512-token pairs.
Secondary confidence=3 and nontrivial-change common cohorts declared before classifier results.
Paired author-cluster intervals and five common seeds specified before model fitting.
Memory-heavy jobs serialized and HTTP generation client made lightweight without changing final model weights, prompts, temperature, seed, token budget or request concurrency.
limitations: Not an external preregistration. Data and feasibility outputs were inspected before final analysis.
Both primary narrative annotations and preservation screens still await independent human adjudication.
